title: DHIS2 Tracked Entity Finder
description: Composable parts and hooks to find one tracked entity within a program's search rules.
docs: Wrap the finder in FinderProvider with a program and an onSelect callback. Inside it compose a FinderForm containing FinderField (exact value) and FinderRangeField (number or date range) inputs, one per program attribute uid, plus an optional FinderHint and a FinderSubmit button. Show matches with FinderResults, which holds the state parts FinderSearching, FinderEmpty, FinderTooMany and FinderError, a FinderList of FinderItem rows with FinderValue cells, and FinderPagination. The program's search rules are enforced inside and cannot be loosened by props. Use the useFinder* hooks for custom layouts. See the tracked entity finder docs page for examples.
